reason: I make about $5,000 a year, so 25 dollars a month is 300 a year, that is a real chunk of my income for something Excel and Telegram already do for free. My staff will not change their habit just because I pay.
objection: I have never paid for a CRM and my team already updates the spreadsheet every evening. 25 dollars a month is too much for 3 people, and no one can show me another shop like mine that uses it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap plan (under 10 dollars) for my small team, plus seeing a shop like mine already using it.
